articles.title: US Stock Market Today S&P 500 Futures Dip As Lower Yields Meet Cost Pressures
articles.mainIdea: US Stock Market Today S&P 500 Futures Dip As Lower Yields Meet Cost Pressures
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: US Stock Market Today S&P 500 Futures Dip As Lower Yields Meet Cost Pressures. The Morning Bull - US Market Morning Update Wednesday, Jan, 7 2026 US stock futures are slightly softer this morning, with the main S&P 500 contracts edging lower while volatility gauges like VIX futures sit around 16.3. The big global story is falling government bond yields in Europe and Poland, which point to easier borrowing costs for households and companies. At the same time, the US Services PMI at 52.5 and Composite PMI at 52.7 show the economy is still growing, just at a slower pace... Related tickers mentioned: SNDK, SOFI, WDC, ^GSPC, ^VIX.

articles.title: Heard on the Street Tuesday Recap: Sandisk Flies Higher
articles.mainIdea: Heard on the Street Tuesday Recap: Sandisk Flies Higher
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Heard on the Street Tuesday Recap: Sandisk Flies Higher. Sandisk soared 28% and is now up almost 900% since its spinoff from Western Digital in February. Western Digital gained 17% and Seagate rose 14%. Huang discussed a new memory-storage platform for Nvidia's latest artificial-intelligence server system, into which it has integrated a host of connectivity and memory-storage products. Related tickers mentioned: AON, HG=F, NVDA, SNDK, STX, WDC.
